. do analysis.do 

. * Workbench 1.8.11
. * project: invalid_fpc
. * run: small_population
. * lineage_hash: ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
> ccc
. * Coverage
. * model | model.ols | native_with_equivalence_note | Full single-stage linear
> ization design including supplied FPC and domain; coefficient and joint-test 
> df preserve the executed Workbench convention.
. version 18

. set more off

. set type double

. capture program drop wb_repost

. program define wb_repost, eclass
  1.     args beta covariance
  2.     ereturn repost b=`beta' V=`covariance', rename
  3. end

. capture program drop wb_sha

. program define wb_sha
  1.     args filename expected
  2.     tempfile digestfile
  3.     shell shasum -a 256 "`filename'" > "`digestfile'"
  4.     tempname fh
  5.     file open `fh' using "`digestfile'", read text
  6.     file read `fh' line
  7.     file close `fh'
  8.     if substr("`line'",1,64) != "`expected'" {
  9.         display as error "SHA256 mismatch"
 10.         exit 9
 11.     }
 12. end

. 
. wb_sha "data.csv" "5c9b770902640ded7af370a8fe7f0e419edec815176c477cbf0bf849d8
> f5ece4"


. frame create wb_src0

. frame change wb_src0

. import delimited using "data.csv", varnames(1) delimiters(",") encoding("UTF-
> 8") asdouble clear case(preserve)
(15 vars, 80 obs)

. frame copy wb_src0 wb_model_data1

. frame change wb_model_data1

. drop if missing(y) | missing(x1) | missing(x2)
(0 observations deleted)

. assert !missing(population) & population >= 0

. quietly summarize population, meanonly

. scalar wb_fpc_fraction = (r(max)<=1)

. if !wb_fpc_fraction assert population>1 & population==floor(population)

. tempvar wb_fpc_order wb_fpc_stratum wb_fpc_psu wb_fpc_tag wb_fpc_n

. generate long `wb_fpc_order' = _n

. egen long `wb_fpc_stratum' = group(stratum)

. egen long `wb_fpc_psu' = group(`wb_fpc_stratum' psu)

. egen byte `wb_fpc_tag' = tag(`wb_fpc_stratum' `wb_fpc_psu')

. bysort `wb_fpc_stratum': egen long `wb_fpc_n' = total(`wb_fpc_tag')

. bysort `wb_fpc_stratum': assert population==population[1]

. if !wb_fpc_fraction assert population>=`wb_fpc_n'

. sort `wb_fpc_order'

. svyset psu [pw=weight], strata(stratum) fpc(population) singleunit(missing)

Sampling weights: weight
             VCE: linearized
     Single unit: missing
        Strata 1: stratum
 Sampling unit 1: psu
           FPC 1: population

. svy: regress y x1 x2
(running regress on estimation sample)

Survey: Linear regression

Number of strata =  8                                 Number of obs   =     80
Number of PSUs   = 16                                 Population size =  1,520
                                                      Design df       =      8
                                                      F(0, 8)         =      .
                                                      Prob > F        =      .
                                                      R-squared       = 0.7871

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
             |             Linearized
           y | Coefficient  std. err.      t    P>|t|     [95% conf. interval]
-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
          x1 |   1.475821          .        .       .            .           .
          x2 |  -.4040448          .        .       .            .           .
       _cons |   4.652712          .        .       .            .           .
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

. assert e(df_r) > 0

. matrix wb_survey_v = e(V)

. mata: assert(!hasmissing(st_matrix("wb_survey_v")))

. estimates store wb_model1

. generate long wb_sample_row = _n

. generate byte wb_sample1 = e(sample)

. scalar wb_number_0 = e(N)

. file open wb_numbers using "numeric_actual.tsv", write text replace
(file numeric_actual.tsv not found)

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_0) _n

. file close wb_numbers

. * Closing self-checks
. assert !missing(wb_number_0) & abs(wb_number_0-(80)) <= 0.0+0.0*abs(80)

. 
end of do-file
